description: This file defines the PackageManagerDisplay class responsible for rendering various HTML UI components for the Package Management system within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for building package and patch displays, license agreements, login panels, and initializing tree views for package categories. The class also manages JavaScript generation for client-side functionality and interfaces with external modules like PackageManager, ModuleInstaller, and Tree to facilitate package installation, updates, and user interactions.

classes.name: PackageManagerDisplay
classes.description: A utility class providing static and instance methods for rendering package management UI components, including package listings, license display, login panels, and the package category tree view. It interacts with external modules to fetch package data and generates HTML/JavaScript code for the SuiteCRM package management interface.

methods.name: buildPackageDisplay
methods.description: Builds the HTML interface for displaying available packages, including tree view, error messages, and control buttons.

methods.name: buildPatchDisplay
methods.description: Builds the HTML interface for patch management, similar to buildPackageDisplay but tailored for patches.

methods.name: buildInstalledGrid
methods.description: Generates a grid listing installed modules or packages with descriptions.

methods.name: buildLoginPanel
methods.description: Creates the login dialog HTML for package repositories requiring authentication.

methods.name: buildGridOutput
methods.description: Constructs the HTML layout for displaying the package category tree and selection controls.

methods.name: buildTreeView
methods.description: Initializes and returns a Tree object representing package categories for UI navigation.

methods.name: getLicenseDisplay
methods.description: Returns HTML form to display a license agreement from a license file.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Checks the connectivity/status of the package repository and returns status text along with boolean flags.

methods.name: buildInstallGrid
methods.description: Builds a grid showing previously installed upgrades and modules with details.

methods.name: buildLicenseOutput
methods.description: Builds inline HTML to display license agreement contents.

methods.name: getDisplayScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript needed for client-side interaction, including package data arrays and event handlers.

methods.name: createJavascriptPackageArray
methods.description: Converts package release data into a JavaScript array string for client-side use.

methods.name: createJavascriptModuleArray
methods.description: Converts module data into a JavaScript array string for client-side use.
